subject: API Design

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Generated OpenAPI spec omits the version segment for TestingController's route
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines / OpenAPI Specification
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the OpenAPI snapshot so paths reflect the actual versioned route (e.g. "/v1/testing/reset"), or confirm the SubstituteApiVersionInUrl option is actually honored by the Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi document generator for attribute-routed, Asp.Versioning-based controllers; update docs/PilotUtilityApi_v1.json accordingly.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: AboutResponse schema omits the ApplicationConfiguration property that the endpoint can return

evidence.excerpt:
[JsonIgnore(Condition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull)]
public IApplicationConfiguration? ApplicationConfiguration { get; set; }

findings.recommendation: The ApplicationConfiguration property is typed as the interface IApplicationConfiguration, which the built-in OpenAPI schema generator appears to skip. Expose it via a concrete DTO/class (or an explicit schema transformer) so GET /about?show-details=true responses are fully documented instead of silently diverging from the published schema.

checkResults.subject: API Design

checkResults.subject: API Design
checkResults.reason: Utility endpoints (/healthcheck, /about) are deliberately version-neutral via [ApiVersionNeutral]; the versioned TestingController follows the resource/controller-name convention consistently.

checkResults.subject: API Design
checkResults.reason: Endpoints return 200/204/400 as appropriate, and [ApiController] client-error handling converts bare BadRequest()/model-binding failures into a consistent ProblemDetails shape, matching the spec.

checkResults.subject: API Design
checkResults.reason: No collection-returning endpoints are present in the files in scope (only /healthcheck, /about, and /testing/reset).

checkResults.subject: API Design
checkResults.reason: Explicit versioning is configured via Asp.Versioning with header/query/URL-segment readers and a default version.

checkResults.subject: API Design
checkResults.reason: No collection endpoints are present in the files in scope to support field selection/filtering.

notes: Scope was limited to SystemController, TestingController, and the Api/OpenApi/Swagger extension folders — the entire controller surface of the app per src/PilotUtiltyApi.Web/Controllers (no other controllers exist). No security-scheme, pagination, or collection-filtering checks apply given the small, non-collection endpoint surface.
